items.source: Return the configured converters for MIME parts.
items.translation: 返回 MIME 部分的配置转换器。

items.source: By default, "multipart/form-data" is used as the content type when writing multipart data. It is also possible to write multipart data using other multipart subtypes such as "multipart/mixed" and "multipart/related", as long as the multipart subtype is registered as a supported media type and the desired multipart subtype is specified as the content type when writing the multipart data. Note that "multipart/mixed" is registered as a supported media type by default.
items.translation: 默认情况下，在写入多部分数据时，使用`"multipart/form-data"`作为内容类型。也可以使用其他多部分子类型（如`"multipart/mixed"`和`"multipart/related"`）来写入多部分数据，前提是已将该多部分子类型注册为支持的内容类型 并且在写入多部分数据时指定了所需的多部分子类型作为内容类型。请注意，`"multipart/mixed"`默认已注册为支持的内容类型。

items.source: When writing multipart data, this converter uses other HttpMessageConverters to write the respective MIME parts. By default, basic converters are registered for byte array, String, and Resource. These can be overridden via setPartConverters(List) or augmented via addPartConverter(HttpMessageConverter).
items.translation: 在编写多部分数据时，此转换器使用其他HttpMessageConverters来编写相应的 MIME 部分。默认情况下，已为字节数组、String和Resource注册了基本转换器。这些可以通过setPartConverters(List)进行覆盖，或通过addPartConverter(HttpMessageConverter)进行扩展。

items.source: In other words, this converter can read and write the "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" media type as MultiValueMap<String, String>, and it can also write (but not read) the "multipart/form-data" and "multipart/mixed" media types as MultiValueMap<String, Object>.
items.translation: 换句话说，此转换器可以读写 "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" 媒体类型作为 MultiValueMap<String, String>，并且它也可以写入（但不能读取）"multipart/form-data" 和 "multipart/mixed" 媒体类型作为 MultiValueMap<String, Object>。

items.source: As of 5.0, this is also used for part headers including Content-Disposition (and its filename parameter) unless (the mutually exclusive) multipartCharset is also set, in which case part headers are encoded as ASCII and filename is encoded with the encoded-word syntax from RFC 2047.
items.translation: 自 5.0 版本起，此功能也用于部分头信息（包括`Content-Disposition`及其文件名参数），除非同时设置了（互斥的）multipartCharset；在这种情况下，部分头信息将编码为 ASCII，而filename则使用 RFC 2047 中的`encoded-word`语法进行编码。

items.source: As of 5.0 by default part headers, including Content-Disposition (and its filename parameter) will be encoded based on the setting of setCharset(Charset) or UTF-8 by default.
items.translation: 自 5.0 版本起，默认情况下，部分头（包括 `Content-Disposition`（及其文件名参数））将根据setCharset(Charset)的设置或默认的`UTF-8`进行编码。

items.source: The default implementation returns Resource.getFilename() if the part is a Resource, and null in other cases. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现如果该部分为`Resource`，则返回Resource.getFilename()，否则返回null。可在子类中重写此方法。
